### What the Tabernacle Reveals
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/what-the-tabernacle-reveals
Passage: Hebrews 9:8-10
Points:
- The tabernacle's structure and priestly duties illustrate the limitations of the old covenant compared to the new covenant in Christ.
- Restricted access behind physical curtains signaled that entrance into God's holy presence was not yet disclosed under that system.
- Although Old Testament believers experienced God's grace by anticipating Christ, the old covenant system itself could not provide access to God.
- Old covenant gifts and sacrifices were merely external regulations incapable of purifying the worshiper's conscience.
- The ceremonial law was never an end in itself, but was designed by the Holy Spirit to point believers to Jesus.
